description: Investigate a production error by analyzing the stack trace in 'error_output.txt'. The error is 'AttributeError: NoneType object has no attribute get' occurring in data_processor.py at line 67. Your tasks: (1) Read error_output.txt to identify the failing line, (2) Navigate to data_processor.py line 67 and understand the bug, (3) Create a file named 'investigation_notes.md' documenting the specific line that failed, the root cause (why address_info is None), and a proposed fix, (4) Add explanatory comments in data_processor.py near line 67 explaining the bug, (5) Implement a defensive fix by adding a None check before calling .get() on address_info (e.g., 'if address_info is not None:' or 'if address_info:'). The root cause is that extract_address_info() can return None when no address data exists, but the code immediately calls .get() without checking. Save all modified files.
